_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id} ku-Tic Tac Toe. Inhloso yakho iwukuwina ezintathu zilandelana (ngokungagxili, ngokuma, noma ngokuphambene) ebhodini. Ngesikhathi sakho, kufanele ukhethe inombolo yesikwele (0-8) ofuna ukubeka uphawu lwakho ngokulandelayo. Isibonelo, '[4]' ibeka uphawu lwakho esitokisini esiphakathi kwebhodi. Njengomdlali {player_id}, uzoba '{symbol}', kanti umphikisi wakho '{opponent_symbol}').

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ukuthutha okulethwe lapha akulandeli ifomethi efanele.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} akuyona inqwaba evumelekile. Kumele ibe phakathi kuka-0 no-8.
